title: Quantum Subentropy: Subadditivity and Sharp Bounds on Discrimination Error
summary: We prove the subadditivity of quantum subentropy for arbitrary bipartite states in finite dimensions and derive a sharp relation between conditional subentropy and minimum discrimination error.

title: A one-third bound for domination in cubic graphs of girth at least six
authors: Kun Cheng, Changlong Shen, Leilei Zhang
summary: We prove Verstraete's conjecture that every cubic graph of order n and girth at least six satisfies the domination number bound gamma(G) <= n/3 in full.

title: Wigner negativity costs phase-space area: A conjectured refinement of the Lieb--Solovej inequality at Rényi order one half
summary: We conjecture a refinement of the Lieb-Solovej inequality relating Wigner logarithmic negativity to Rényi entropy, and show it suffices to prove it for pure states.

title: Circle-Pattern Linear Systems for the Twenty Trivalent Delaunay Types of a Genus-Two Surface: Rank, Feasibility and Polytope Dimension
summary: We prove that the rank of the angle system matrix A equals 6 for all twenty trivalent Delaunay types of a genus-two surface.

title: Symmetries, conservation laws, series solutions and singularity formation for the spherically symmetric Euler-Poisson equations in mass coordinates
summary: We determine all point symmetries of the spherically symmetric Euler-Poisson equations in mass coordinates for a polytropic gas.

title: Super-Multiplicativity of the Noncommutative Minimum and Applications to Quantum Privacy and Hypothesis Testing
authors: Theshani Nuradha, Sujeet Bhalerao, Christoph Hirche et al.
summary: We prove that the noncommutative minimum of positive semidefinite operators is super-multiplicative across tensor products.

title: The $T1$ theorem under Dini regularity
summary: The authors prove the T1 theorem for Calderón-Zygmund operators under the classical Dini regularity condition, solving a longstanding open problem in singular integral theory.

title: Disc functionals and rational curves
authors: Yinji Li, Haoyuan Sun, Zhiwei Wang et al.
summary: We prove a criterion for the existence of rational curves on compact Kähler manifolds using disc functionals, obtaining a transcendental version of the Miyaoka-Mori theorem.

title: Perfect Spin-to-Charge Signal Conversion via Inverse Spin Hall Effect in a Superconductor
authors: Rodrigo de las Heras, Ilya V. Tokatly, F. Sebastian Bergeret
summary: We show that superconductivity can overcome limitations of the conventional spin Hall effect and enable near-unity spin-to-charge signal conversion in a nonlocal spin-valve geometry.

title: Linear forms in logarithms of rational numbers: an ineffective measure with the best possible exponent
summary: We establish an ineffective measure with the best possible exponent for linear forms in logarithms of rational numbers using induction on n.

title: Contact rigidity and Poisson bracket invariants
summary: We study C0-rigidity and Poisson bracket invariants on closed contact manifolds, proving Poisson commutation is closed under uniform convergence and establishing weak rigidity and lower semicontinuity properties.

title: Gaussian Belief Propagation and Periodic Jacobi Matrices on Trees: Spectral Curve, Antibound Poles, and Fixed Points
summary: Diagonal Green functions of a periodic Jacobi operator satisfy scalar Gaussian belief propagation covariance equations, proving the conjecture of Christiansen, Simon and Zinchenko.

title: Local redundancies are necessary for long-lived memories in finite spatial dimensions
authors: Chao Yin, Yaodong Li, Benedikt Placke et al.
summary: We prove a no-go theorem for exponentially long-lived thermal memories based on the structure of local redundancies among Hamiltonian terms in finite spatial dimensions.

title: Improved Lower Bound on the Hadwiger-Debrunner Numbers
summary: We prove improved lower bounds on Hadwiger-Debrunner numbers for families of convex sets in dimension at least two.

title: How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions
summary: We determine the exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions, showing they follow a precise three-regime law based on the switch budget.

title: Limit distributions and bootstrap for smooth adapted Wasserstein distances
summary: We provide limit theorems and bootstrap results for Gaussian-smoothed adapted Wasserstein distances under compact support assumptions.

title: The categorical graph minor conjecture and matching complexes
summary: We disprove the categorical graph minor conjecture by showing it fails for the module assigning to each graph the free module on its spanning trees.

title: Moonshine Conjecture Formalized
summary: We formalize the Moonshine Conjecture in Lean and discuss the challenges regarding whether formal statements truly express intended mathematical meanings.

title: Recognizing $k$-inducible Digraphs is NP-complete
summary: We prove that deciding whether a tournament is 3-inducible is NP-complete, resolving the complexity of k-inducible digraphs for fixed k >= 3.

title: On the chromatic splitting conjecture in coheight $1$
authors: Tobias Barthel, Lucas Mann, Rin Ray et al.
summary: We confirm predictions of Hopkins' chromatic splitting conjecture in stable homotopy theory using methods from p-divisible groups and p-adic geometry.

title: Kneser-Tits over fields of cohomological dimension $\le 2$ (with an appendix by Alexis Bouthier and Federico Scavia)
summary: We settle the Kneser-Tits problem over every field of separable cohomological dimension at most 2, resolving a conjecture of Gille.

title: The Tamura-Shafer Problem for Monoids
summary: We prove that every monoid is reconstructible from its power semigroup among arbitrary semigroups.

title: Nonperturbative Bounds on the Ground-State Energy of Lattice QED
summary: We establish nonperturbative bounds on the ground-state energy of lattice quantum electrodynamics within the Gaussian photon approximation using a spectral comparison theorem.

title: Quantum Dobrushin comparison and locality of fermionic equilibrium states
authors: Lennart Becker, Harman Preet Singh, Stefan Teufel
summary: We prove a quantum analogue of Dobrushin's comparison theorem for lattice fermions, providing a tool for proving uniqueness of equilibrium states and decay of correlations.

title: The non symmetric Hikita conjecture
summary: We construct local and global comparison maps for the Hikita conjecture in quiver gauge theories and study their analogues for finite non symmetric Cartan pairs.

title: Verifying and Strengthening Neural Tangent Kernel Theory
summary: We present a Lean 4 formalisation for two-layer neural networks, providing a machine-checked end-to-end theorem that gradient flow exists uniquely in the lazy-training regime.

title: Rigidity and Non-Rigidity of Disk Pseudo-Rotations below $C^2$
summary: We prove C0-rigidity of area-preserving C^{1,beta} disk pseudo-rotations with non-Brjuno rotation numbers and examine non-rigidity at the C1 endpoint and bi-Lipschitz class.

title: Real Principal-Minor Detectors: Normal Forms and Regular Parity Lifts
summary: We prove that a symmetric matrix over F_2 has a real principal-minor detector if and only if it has a specific bordered form with a skew-symmetric matrix.

title: Safe Subgame Resolving in Multiplayer Games
summary: We prove the first conditional safety theorem for safe subgame resolving in multiplayer games with uncorrelated strategies.

title: Degree Lower Bounds for Symmetric Boolean Functions: Breaking the Prime-Gap Barrier
summary: We prove that every nonconstant symmetric Boolean function on n variables has exact real polynomial degree at least n - O(n^{1/3}(\log n)^{2/3}).

title: Sightline: Calibrated Data-Flow Summaries for LLM-Integrated Applications
authors: Zihao Xu, Yuekang Li, Ruitao Feng et al.
summary: We prove and mechanize in Lean 4 data-flow summaries for LLM-integrated applications.

title: Constructible properties of minimal models
summary: We prove that the subset of the base parametrizing fibers isomorphic or birationally equivalent to a given minimal model is constructible in the Zariski topology, providing new finiteness results predicted by the relative Kawamata--Morrison--Totaro cone conjecture.

title: Rational Designs and Prouhet--Tarry--Escott Problems
authors: Ryutaro Misawa, Masanori Sawa, Filip Špiranec
summary: We prove the existence of rational designs on spheres, orthogonal and unitary groups, real and complex Grassmannians, and ellipsoids, answering Bannai's Problem and solving Xiang's conjecture in every dimension.

title: A complete intersection theorem for sets of bounded size
summary: We prove a complete intersection theorem for largest t-intersecting families of subsets of size at most k, settling a 2002 conjecture of Ahlswede, Bey, Engel, and Khachatrian.

title: A very robust Ramsey theorem for hypergraph matchings
summary: We show that a very weak quasirandomness assumption, namely being a sublinear connector, suffices for the exact Ramsey property for matchings in r-uniform hypergraphs.

title: A proof of the Lyons-Pemantle-Peres monotonicity conjecture for high offspring laws
summary: We prove the Lyons-Pemantle-Peres conjecture for high enough offspring laws, showing that the speed satisfies the inequality for the entire transient regime of the bias.

title: Plane curves attaining the Dimca-Sernesi bound and Jacobian syzygies of pencil-type curves
summary: We show that curves of pencil type are Dimca-Sernesi extremal, with the minimal syzygy explicitly determined.

title: Simple Private Noisy SGD is Minimax-Optimal under Population Strong Convexity
summary: We resolve an open question by upper bounding the parameter estimation error for a single pass of Noisy SGD under population strong convexity.

title: Amplitude dependent wave envelope type estimates for moment curves and applications
summary: We prove amplitude dependent wave envelope type estimates for moment curves, establishing sharp small cap decoupling inequalities and proving a conjecture on exponential sums.

title: Existence and Uniqueness of Mild Solutions to Rough Stochastic Partial Differential Equations driven by Fractional Brownian Motion with Hurst Index $H > 1/4$
summary: We prove a theorem on the unique solvability of the Cauchy problem for a stochastic partial differential equation driven by fractional Brownian motion.

title: The envelope property for unibranch projective varieties (with an appendix on the singular Yau-Tian-Donaldson conjecture)
authors: Yanbo Fang, Jiyuan Han, Mingchen Xia
summary: We prove the envelope property for every real numerical class on an integral unibranch projective variety, which characterizes unibranchness by the plurisubharmonic envelope property.

title: A Tensor-Algebraic No-Go Theorem for High-Dimensional Photonic Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger States Discovered with AlphaProof Nexus
authors: Mario Krenn, Moritz Firsching, George Tsoukalas et al.
summary: We prove that no complex-weighted monochromatic quantum graph exists for any even N>=4 when D>=N, using AI-assisted formal proof search in Lean.

title: Dense induced bipartite subgraphs under local sparsity
authors: Peiru Kuang, Jing Lin, Yan Wang
summary: We prove that every K_{t,t}-free graph of minimum degree at least d contains an induced bipartite subgraph of average degree at least log d - 16t log log d.

title: Oscillatory integral operators of arbitrary signature: beyond the universal estimates
authors: Fernando Ballesta-Yagüe, Jonathan Hickman, Hrit Roy
summary: We prove Lp to Lp estimates for Hörmander oscillatory integral operators that go beyond the universal range in odd dimensions under mild non-compression hypotheses.

title: Full Rank and Stable Sampling of $\tanh$ Networks
summary: We characterize parameters where the differential of the realization map for tanh networks has full rank and prove uniform-norm Lipschitz stability.

title: An asymptotic bound for Yuster's independent transversal factor conjecture
summary: We prove an asymptotic bound for Yuster's independent transversal factor conjecture, showing the partition exists whenever n >= r + O(r^{20/21}).

title: The existence of generalized Steiner systems
authors: Xuan Wang, Shitao Li, Minjia Shi
summary: This paper investigates generalized Steiner systems and establishes their asymptotic existence for general fixed parameters.

title: Uniform Positivity of the $F$-Signature and Pure Descent of klt Singularities
summary: The authors affirmatively answer the question on the uniform positivity of the F-signature, prove a converse establishing uniform lower bounds for klt type singularities, and provide a new reduction-mod-p proof of Zhuang's theorem.

title: On the dimension of $V$-variable fractals
summary: The authors prove the conjecture that the V-variable Hausdorff dimension converges to the random recursive dimension as V approaches infinity.

title: Proof of Stanley's Conjecture on the Leading Ehrhart Coefficients of the Birkhoff Polytope
summary: The authors prove that the ratio of specific coefficients in the Ehrhart polynomial of the Birkhoff polytope asymptotically matches Stanley's conjecture for every fixed nonnegative integer k.

title: A One-Sided Liouville Theorem and a Critical Sparse-Support Inverse Theorem for Discrete Harmonic Functions
summary: The authors answer a one-sided Liouville question by proving that a real harmonic function on Z^2 is constant if it is nonnegative on a sufficiently high proportion of every large centered square.

title: Strong chromatic index of graphs with Ore-degree at most nine
authors: Xiaoxue Hu, Jiangxu Kong, Yu Xue
summary: The authors prove that every finite loopless multigraph with an Ore-degree at most nine has a strong chromatic index of at most 28, verifying the Erdős-Nešetřil conjecture for simple graphs of maximum degree 3.

title: A proof of Casselman's comparison conjecture
summary: We prove Casselman's comparison conjecture for parabolic subgroups of real linear reductive groups, showing that a natural inclusion induces a topological L-equivariant isomorphism.

title: Trimmed Branching Brownian Motion with Discontinuous Drift
authors: Rami Atar, Leonid Mytnik, Dominic T. Schickentanz
summary: As particle number tends to infinity and cell size tends to zero, we prove convergence in probability of the empirical measure process to a deterministic limit characterized by a parabolic free obstacle problem.

title: Super quantum groups of divided powers à la Lusztig
summary: We construct super analogues of quantum groups of divided powers, showing they admit PBW-type bases, Lusztig isomorphisms, and a Frobenius-type morphism.

title: Preventing cycles in Lotka--Volterra systems
authors: Matheus C. Bortolan, Piotr Kalita, José Antonio Langa et al.
summary: We prove that generalized strict diagonal dominance makes the invasion, connection, and weak graphs acyclic for every intrinsic growth vector in Lotka-Volterra systems without hyperbolicity assumptions.

title: Euler up-down numbers and quiver representations
authors: Giovanni Cerulli Irelli, Evgeny Feigin, Markus Reineke
summary: We show that Euler up-down numbers enumerate isoclasses of representations arising from quiver Grassmannians providing an explicit realization of PBW degenerate flag varieties.

title: Hilbert functions over the exterior algebra and f-vectors in higher rank III: Lattice points of the Kozlov polytope
summary: We study the lattice points of the Kozlov polytope and show that the Kozlov simplex is a lecture hall simplex.

title: Minimal primes and radicality of join-meet ideals of modular lattices with one diamond
summary: We describe the minimal primes of the join-meet ideal of a finite modular lattice with one diamond, characterize its radicality, and prove when it is unmixed.

title: Microscopic Probabilities for U-Statistics and Almost-Balanced Permutations
summary: We prove sharp probability bounds for U-statistics to lie within $C/n$ of a target, settling a question of Beniamini, Lavee and Linial.

title: Symmetry of pole order spectra and freeness of plane curves
summary: We show that the pole order spectrum of the top cohomology of a reduced plane curve's Milnor fiber satisfies a symmetry relation if and only if the curve is free.

title: Rigidity of ordinal spaces
authors: Yi Zhou, Jiaheng Zhuang, Shuguo Zhang
summary: We show that the Sorgenfrey plane is not rigid and prove in ZF that every regular uncountable cardinal with the tree property is rigid.

title: A new second-moment method for spectral measures of inhomogeneous non-Hermitian random matrices
summary: We develop a second-moment method for the empirical spectral distribution of non-Hermitian random matrices and prove the circular law for doubly stochastic profiles.

title: Quasipolynomial pyjamas
summary: We prove an improved upper bound of $\exp((\log \varepsilon^{-1})^{50000})$ rotations for the Pyjama Problem.

title: Multiplicative Sidon basis
summary: We prove the existence of a multiplicative Sidon set which is an asymptotic basis of order 2 using the probabilistic method.

title: Pathwise uniqueness for the stochastic heat equation with a $3/4$-Hölder diffusion coefficient
authors: Pei-Sen Li, Jie Xiong, Xu Yang
summary: We prove pathwise uniqueness and strong existence for the stochastic heat equation with a $3/4$-Hölder diffusion coefficient, settling the critical case left open by Mueller, Mytnik and Perkins.

title: Hypergraph Hajnal-Szemerédi
authors: Michelle Delcourt, Cicely Henderson, Thomas Lesgourgues et al.
summary: The authors study the extension of the Hajnal-Szemerédi theorem to hypergraph $K_q^r$-factors, building upon previous degree bound results for large uniform hypergraphs.

title: Generic arm separation for planar percolation models
authors: Loïc Gassmann, Ioan Manolescu, Maran Mohanarangan
summary: We provide a very generic statement of arm separation that applies to arbitrary planar percolation models, based on exploring configurations conditioned on the existence of arms.

title: Budget Internalization: Fixed-Budget RLVR Trades Test-Time Scaling for In-Budget Accuracy
authors: Ilia Zavidnyi, Alexander Kovrigin, Arina Puchkova et al.
summary: This paper investigates how training reasoning models with a fixed rollout cap via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards turns the cap into a learned constraint that limits test-time scaling.

title: Harish-Chandra isomorphism over arbitrary base rings
summary: We prove that Harish-Chandra projection induces a natural, strict filtered isomorphism for a split connected reductive group scheme over Z and any commutative ring R.

title: Analyticity of $\operatorname{Sine}_β$ pair correlations
authors: Yun Li, Yahui Qu, Benedek Valkó et al.
summary: We prove that the pair correlation function of Sine_beta extends holomorphically in beta to Re beta > 0 at every fixed nonzero separation.

title: Combinatorial Dvoretzky Theory
summary: We prove two upper bounds on the mean width of an n-dimensional polytope contained in the Euclidean unit ball in terms of its number of facets.

title: Sharp topological overlap in every dimension
summary: We show that the maximum topological overlap constant equals the affine overlap constant, confirming a conjecture of Bukh, Matousek, and Nivasch.

title: Convergence of the Most Probable Transition Paths in Multiscale Systems
authors: Qiqi Lian, Shanqi Liu, Jinqiao Duan
summary: This paper studies the convergence behavior of the most probable transition paths in a class of multiscale stochastic dynamical systems using Euler-Lagrange equations and Gamma-convergence.

title: Invariant real curves arising from semiconjugacies of rational maps
summary: We prove that every invariant curve arising from a semiconjugacy of a non-exceptional polynomial of degree at least two is contained in a generalized circle.

title: Power topologies and uniformities on bistochastic operators
summary: We prove that the set of invertible Koopman operators is dense in the space of bistochastic operators in the polynomial weak topology.

title: Prime-Power Expansions and Boundary Corrections for the Secular Coefficients of Riemann-Zero Windows
summary: We derive a symmetric prime-power model for the generating function of secular coefficients of Riemann-zero windows.

title: Maximum signless Laplacian spectral radius of graphs with given minimum degree and edge connectivity
summary: We solve the extremal graph problem for maximum signless Laplacian spectral radius across the entire range of edge connectivity.

title: Rational multisections and unirationality of supersingular K3 surfaces
summary: We prove that every supersingular K3 surface of Artin invariant at most nine is unirational, confirming a long-standing question.

title: Multiple Positive Solutions of Minkowski-Curvature Neumann Problems with a Two-Step Indefinite Weight
summary: We prove the existence of at least N distinct positive solutions for Minkowski-curvature Neumann problems with a two-step sign-changing weight.

title: Rational maps with at most three critical values have no Herman rings
authors: Yuming Fu, Weiwei Su, Fei Yang
summary: We prove that any rational map with at most three critical values has no Herman rings.

title: Uniform Bounds of $F$-Signature and Effective Ideal Containments
summary: We establish inequalities between numerical invariants and ideal containments, and resolve the Uniform Symbolic Topology Problem.

title: Optimal long-time derivative estimates for underdamped Langevin dynamics
summary: We prove optimal long-time derivative bounds for the semigroup generated by the underdamped Langevin operator in $L^2(\mu)$ spaces under a weighted relative Hessian bound.

title: Finite groups with a fixed-point-free automorphism satisfying an irreducible identity
summary: We prove that finite groups with a fixed-point-free automorphism satisfying an irreducible identity are nilpotent of bounded class, extending solutions to the Frobenius conjecture and restricted Burnside problem.

title: Polynomial Spaces Are Locally Paley-Wiener: Bulk Universality and Christoffel Asymptotics on Symmetric Convex Bodies
summary: We prove a bulk universality limit for total-degree polynomial spaces on symmetric convex bodies, showing convergence of the rescaled reproducing kernel to the Fourier integral over a local spectral body.

title: Taylor expansions for first-passage time distributions of Brownian motion with moving boundaries
summary: We prove that the boundary-to-distribution map for Brownian motion first-passage time is infinitely differentiable along the Cameron-Martin space and derive its Taylor expansion with explicit error bounds.

title: The distribution of greatest common divisors of binomial coefficients and their upper indices
summary: We establish an asymptotic counting formula for the number of integers $n \le x$ where the greatest common divisor of $n$ and a binomial coefficient equals a fixed integer $d \ge 2$.

title: Quantitative approximations for finite-state mean-field configuration models
summary: We establish quantitative approximations and Bernstein-type concentration inequalities for the empirical measures of finite-state mean-field particle systems.

title: Determinant Massey products
authors: Oisín Flynn-Connolly, José M. Moreno-Fernández, Fernando Muro
summary: We introduce determinant Massey products for commutative dg algebras, relate them to classical and matric Massey products, and provide counterexamples in characteristic 2.

title: Self-verifiable LLM-driven science and why it needs human researchers
authors: Michael G. Medvedev, Nikolai V. Krivoshchapov, Stepan N. Ostarkov
summary: We discuss how proof assistants like Lean 4 and Coq solve the reliability problem of LLM-generated science through formal verification.

title: Reinforcement Learning Unlearns Corrupted SFT Reasoning
authors: Anika Misra, Shreyas Vinod, Huteng Dai
summary: We show that Group Relative Policy Optimization post-training successfully restores mathematical reasoning accuracy despite severe supervised fine-tuning data corruption.

title: Nilpotent skew-symmetric tridiagonal Bohemian matrices: a proof of Corless's conjecture
summary: We prove Corless's conjecture that skew-symmetric tridiagonal Bohemian matrices with superdiagonal in {1, i} can be nilpotent only for specific dimensions and vector forms.

title: Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes
authors: Yang Cai, Vineet Gupta, Yanchen Jiang et al.
summary: We make progress on the sample compression conjecture, showing near-quadratic sample compression bounds for all VC classes.

title: The rational points of the non-split Cartan modular curve of level 121
summary: We prove that the modular curve X_{ns}^+(121) has exactly seven rational points, all of them CM, determining the 11-adic images of Galois of non-CM elliptic curves over Q.

title: Convexity is overrated: Shortest paths on 4-polytopes are hard to compute
summary: We prove that computing geodesic distance on the boundary of a rational convex 4-polytope is NP-hard and disprove several conjectures.

title: A disproof of the van Emde Boas--Kruyswijk conjecture on the Davenport constant
authors: Weidong Gao, Alfred Geroldinger, Guoqing Wang et al.
summary: We disprove the long-standing van Emde Boas--Kruyswijk conjecture on the Davenport constant for every exponent $n=2k$ with $k\ge3$ odd.

title: The Lyapunov and uniform spectra
summary: We resolve deficiencies in the Lyapunov spectrum of a linear cocycle by introducing a larger set called the uniform spectrum.

title: A Poisson boundary solution to Connes' bicentralizer conjecture and Kadison's problem on MASA
summary: We provide a completely new proof of Connes' bicentralizer conjecture and prove Marrakchi's relative bicentralizer conjecture using the weak Dixmier property.

title: A Unifying Metatheorem on Weak-Memory Robustness
authors: Giovanna Kobus Conrado, Stephan Spengler, Mohamed Faouzi Atig et al.
summary: We present a unifying metatheorem on weak-memory robustness to simplify checking program behaviors under various memory models.

title: From Sorry to QED: Refining LLM Math Proofs via Angelic Execution
authors: Yanju Chen, Hanzhi Liu, Ruizhe Qian et al.
summary: We present MathEye, a framework that converts imperfect LLM-generated proof scripts into fully verified Lean proofs using angelic execution.

title: MCTS Is Counting the Wrong Thing: Learning Exploration Counts for LLM Reasoning
authors: Xuan Zhang, Zhijian Zhou, Zicheng Hu et al.
summary: Our theoretical analysis shows that visit count fragmentation in standard UCT can impair exploration efficiency in LLM reasoning.

title: Logical Relations on Display
authors: Steven Schaefer, Johnson He, Max S. New
summary: Using category theory and universal properties, we develop semantic frameworks to improve the reuse of metatheory and proof developments in programming languages.

title: CompCert4Lean: Porting a Verified C Compiler to Lean in Six Weeks with Parallel Coding Agents
authors: Cong Wang, Zhiyang Chen, Fan Long et al.
summary: We present CompCert4Lean, a large-scale port of CompCert's verified compiler core to Lean, successfully discharging all proof obligations without project-specific axioms.

title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
authors: Haocheng Wang, Weixuan Yuan, Florian Hübler et al.
summary: We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework to autoformalize program specifications via executable postconditions.

title: Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research
authors: Yang Chen, Qianyi Wang, Ronghui Yang et al.
summary: We introduce Turing Agent, an agent harness designed to orchestrate end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics.

title: Reusing formal Vlasov-Maxwell proofs to certify plasma solver outputs
summary: We reuse a Lean 4 relativistic Vlasov-Maxwell library theorem and numerical bounds to provide particle-free references for particle-in-cell simulations, exposing boundary and initialization errors in WarpX.

title: Strong Standard Completeness of a Hypersequent Calculus for Cyclic Involutive Residuated Lattices
summary: We present a hypersequent calculus for cyclic involutive residuated lattices and prove strong standard completeness for arbitrary theories in a countable propositional language.

title: TrustBound: Mechanized Completeness for Payment Epochs Initiated by AI Agents
authors: Sandip Nandi, Aishwarya Bose, Apurba Bose et al.
summary: We give a Lean model and prove that admission fencing fixes a journal covering every modeled effect and outstanding right for AI agent payment operations.

title: Maximality of the Došen-Petrić Boolean Category
summary: We prove that the zero-identity Boolean category of Došen and Petrić is maximal and provide a Lean formalization of these proofs.

title: Formalizing Formal Semantics: The Formal Atlas
summary: We present the Formal Atlas, a system for studying natural language semantics using proof assistants to formalize and check semantic accounts.

title: From Pen-and-Paper to Machine-Checked Proofs: Lean for System Identification
authors: Manas Mejari, Dario Piga, Marco Forgione
summary: This paper introduces the Lean 4 proof assistant to a system identification and control audience using machine-checked proofs.

title: How rigid is maximum cardinality search? Stability and locality of MCS orderings under edge updates, verified in Lean
authors: Md Thoriqul Islam Thonmay, Gregory Morse
summary: We prove in Lean that two graphs share a maximum cardinality search ordering whenever specific neighbor count conditions hold along every proper common prefix, and verify that inserting or deleting a matching preserves a common ordering.

title: No free lattice contains an infinite ascending chain of copies of FL(3)
summary: We prove that no free lattice contains an infinite strictly ascending chain of sublattices isomorphic to the free lattice on three generators, answering an open question by R. A. Dean.

title: Lean-PEP: Performance-Estimation Certificates to Formally Verified Algorithmic Bounds
summary: Lean-PEP provides a reusable interface to turn performance-estimation certificates into formal theorems with verified bounds.

title: Propositional Dynamic Logic without tests does not have Craig Interpolation
summary: We answer an open question negatively by providing a counterexample showing that test-free Propositional Dynamic Logic does not have Craig Interpolation.

title: daVinci-Prover: Agent-Native Mid-Training for Formal Theorem Proving
authors: Wenhong Zhu, Xuefeng Li, Jiashuo Zhang et al.
summary: We synthesize an agent-native 33.7B-token mid-training corpus for formal theorem proving covering decomposition, search, and self-verification.

title: The multiplicative complexity of the three-bit low-half multiplier
summary: We prove that the multiplicative complexity of the three-bit low-half multiplier is six, using a structural lower-bound proof fully formalized in Lean.

title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions: A Proof-Relevant Type Theory for Verified Science
summary: We introduce a proof-relevant type theory for verified science that replaces judgmental proof irrelevance with typed knowledge over constructive institutions to allow inspection and comparison of independent derivations.

title: Advancing Weighted Partial MaxSAT Solving via Differentiable GPU Guidance
authors: Mingju Liu, Curie Kim, Steve Dai et al.
summary: We present a GPU-CPU hybrid framework for Weighted Partial MaxSAT that complements CPU solvers with differentiable GPU optimization.

title: Finite-Cadence Refresh Equilibria for Streaming Prior-Anchored Ridge: A Closed-Form Forgetting Window and Spectral Correction
summary: We show that the moving-frame offset converges to a finite-cadence equilibrium that lags the pure-leaky path while reducing estimation variance by an explicit factor.

title: ProofCoder: Continuous Reasoning for Automated Software Verification
authors: Martim Afonso, Inês Lynce, Maurizio Morisio et al.
summary: We introduce ProofCoder, an agentic proof-synthesis system for Rocq that approaches theorem proving from a coding-agent perspective.

title: Megrez: A Knowledge-Guided Agent for Formal Mathematics over MK Set Theory
summary: We present Megrez, a knowledge-guided formalization agent for Rocq libraries built on Morse-Kelley set theory.

title: Operator Learning of Microstructure-Dependent Internal-Variable Models for Inelastic Homogenization: Approximation and Complexity
authors: Lianghao Cao, George Stepaniants, Andrew M. Stuart
summary: We study the approximation and complexity of learning homogenized constitutive laws for inelastic heterogeneous materials using recurrent neural operators.

title: Trust, but verify, audit and attribute: a human-in-the-loop framework for checking AI-produced research results
authors: György Eigner, Patrik P. Süli, Roland Hollós
summary: This paper examines the human-in-the-loop framework for verifying AI-produced research results and highlights that deciding whether a Lean proof translation is faithful to the author's text is undecidable in general.

title: Spectral Stability, Fatou Basin Contraction, and Machine-Checked Multipliers in Holomorphic Extensions of Generalized Syracuse Dynamics
authors: Volkan Dağlı, Zerrin Dağlı, Dağhan Dağlı et al.
summary: We embed Syracuse and Collatz maps into C and prove spectral stability, Fatou basin contraction, and machine-checked multipliers in Lean.

title: Improving Analytic Constants via Interpretable AI-Guided Lean Proof Refinement
authors: Rahul Saha, Alan Li, Anton Xue et al.
summary: We introduce an interpretable framework for AI-guided mathematical discovery by representing proofs as partially-formalized Lean blueprints to tighten slack in intermediate lemmas.

title: A trace costs one quantifier: the exact complexity of perfect play in nonlocal games
summary: We prove that the existence of a perfect normal spatial strategy in a finite nonlocal game is Sigma-0-2-complete, even when restricted to games of value one.

title: LeanDojo-v2: A Comprehensive Library for AI-Assisted Theorem Proving in Lean
authors: Ryan Hsiang, William Adkisson, Robert Joseph George et al.
summary: We introduce LeanDojo-v2, an end-to-end framework unifying repository data extraction, LLM fine-tuning, proof search, and theorem proving in Lean.

title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
authors: Yifan Luo, Zhengying Liu, Yang Yuan et al.

title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions
summary: This volume presents the theory of Eigenius, a store of typed knowledge over constructive institutions, developing its metatheory based on dependent type theory.
